MDPI Layout Reviewer

Check a .docx manuscript against The MDPI Layout Style Guide and get back a Word file with comments on what to fix. You can also compare the Original with the Done file to find content lost during layout, or compare the XML with the Word file character by character.

Style Guide 11th ed. · Dec 2025 Runs in your browser. Files are never uploaded.

Parts to check and comment on

Comments mark only the problems found. Any comments already in the file are removed before the new ones are added. Alignment, spacing and left indent are not checked. The comment author is “MDPI Layout Checker”; remove them all with Review → Delete All Comments.

Results appear here after the check.
